newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended mixed after a quiet day, with some markets closed due to a European holiday.
"The volume was concentrated in the morning. Otherwise it was market makers amongst themselves," one Swiss trader said.
German bonds weakened on the day, undermining a early slightly firmer tone in the Swiss market.

New issues dominated trade, with Swiss energy provider Atel launching a 200 million Swiss franc bond for 12 years. Swiss Raiffeisen banks also launched a 100 million 4-1/4 percent offering for 10 years. UBS led both issues.
ZURICH, Jan 6 (Reuter) - Swiss bonds ended mixed with some renewed pressure on prices in the short end, while longer maturities tended firmer.
"Both of those issues met excellent demand," one syndicate manager at a Swiss bank said.

But he said demand was somewhat lagging for the two foreign issues. These included a 150 million Swiss franc five-year bond for SuedwestLB, and a 300 million franc six-year offering by a Deutsche Bank unit.
SuedwestLB, which featured a low coupon of 2.50 percent, priced at 99.20, may find favour for those seeking tax advantages, the syndicate manager said.
Mar Conf futures CONFH7 steady at 115.72.
Mar Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 up 20 at 110.80
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 down three at 98.09.
